operation_safety.method: code fix to src/acquisition/b2z_durable_execution.py + regression tests (tmp_path/FakeTransport only), then ONE authorized append to the real live event ledger recording an already-earned terminal state -- no dispatch, no retry

incident.observed_symptom: the human ran the manual resume loop and it printed 17 identical {"result_written_to": ...} lines with no visible progress
incident.durable_state_confirmed: the event ledger was byte-identical across all 17 invocations (sha256 10b1671f..., 12 events, 5 physical requests consumed) -- ZERO new events, ZERO new physical requests. The result artifact was also unchanged, always reporting {"status": "NO_EVIDENCE_NO_CANDIDATE", "sample_ordinal": 3, "stage": "FUNDING_TX"}.
incident.safety_confirmed: this was NOT a budget leak or a semantic failure -- zero physical requests were consumed across all 17 invocations, and no ledger drift or corruption occurred. It was a pure liveness bug: safe but permanently stuck.

root_cause.function: resume_next()'s STAGE_FUNDING_TX branch in src/acquisition/b2z_durable_execution.py (pre-fix, around line 605)
root_cause.mechanism: when CREATOR_HISTORY's stage output has no_candidate=True, the branch returns {"status": "NO_EVIDENCE_NO_CANDIDATE", ...} WITHOUT ever appending any event to the event ledger. _stage_for_next() determines a member's next incomplete stage by checking succeeded_stage_keys(), which only included ATTEMPT_SUCCEEDED and LOCAL_PREDICTION_SEEDED events -- so FUNDING_TX for a no-candidate member was NEVER marked complete, and _stage_for_next() kept returning FUNDING_TX as "next incomplete" forever.
root_cause.why_it_blocks_all_later_ordinals: resume_next()'s member loop iterates manifest.members in ordinal order and processes AT MOST ONE stage per call, returning immediately once it finds a member with an incomplete stage. Since ordinal 3 (earlier than 4-20) permanently reported FUNDING_TX as incomplete, EVERY subsequent call re-entered ordinal 3's STAGE_FUNDING_TX branch, re-derived the same no_candidate result, and returned -- never reaching ordinal 4 or any later member.
root_cause.distinguishing_feature_from_the_executio: this is a DIFFERENT bug from the earlier B2Z-P2R fix (which addressed unexcluded FAILED_AFTER_DISPATCH stages raising an error). NO_EVIDENCE_NO_CANDIDATE never raised an error at all -- it silently returned success (exit 0) every time, which is why the shell loop's `if rc -ne 0` stop condition never triggered and why 17 invocations ran without any visible failure.

fix.resume_next_updated: the STAGE_FUNDING_TX no-candidate branch now calls record_no_candidate_terminal() (idempotently, checking no_candidate_terminal_ordinals() first) before returning the NO_EVIDENCE_NO_CANDIDATE result
fix.consumes_zero_physical_requests: NO_CANDIDATE_TERMINAL is not in the event-name set dispatched_stage_keys()/physical_requests_attempted() filter for, structurally identical to how EXECUTION_EXCLUDED and LOCAL_PREDICTION_SEEDED are excluded
fix.does_not_change_the_terminal_result_retu: resume_next() still returns exactly {"status": "NO_EVIDENCE_NO_CANDIDATE", ...} for the FIRST call reaching this state -- the fix only changes what gets durably recorded, not the contract-facing return value
